6695b0f13bfda3ab.description: The role You will be the one designer who owns the student experience. Primarily that means the student app: where students study, work with an AI tutor, answer questions, and take part in activities, including games and head-to-head duels on a topic. You will also shape parts of the live classroom experience. This is a Senior/Principal-level individual contributor Product Designer role. There is no design team underneath you and no manager drawing your roadmap. You take a problem from the first student conversation to the shipped screen, and you decide what to look at next. Why this role One owner of the whole student experience, with a direct line to leadership. Speed: with AI in the workflow, ideas go from research to release in days, not quarters. An experimentation practice being built from the ground up, with you shaping it. A company expanding into more schools, with a long-term ambition to match. What you will do Spend real time with students in Saudi schools. Interviews, focus groups, classroom observation. Turn what you hear into design decisions, and go back to check them. Design for Saudi Arabia, not for the generic "best practice" app. Patterns that work in London or San Francisco often fail here. You know why, and you can show it in your work. Own the student app end to end. Flows, information architecture, prototypes, final UI, and the handover to engineering. Design activities students want to come back to, games and duels included, with learning as the gate: an activity that is more fun but teaches less is a regression. Run experiments. State a hypothesis, build the variants, agree the metric, and read the result honestly. You will help build the experimentation practice, not just use it. Work AI-native. Use AI tools for generation, prototyping and production so your time goes to research and judgement. We care about the quality of your decisions, not how many pixels you pushed by hand. Desired Candidate Profile Roughly 5 years of experience in UX, product design experience. We care less about the number and more about how many people you have interviewed and what you did with it. A research practice you can describe in detail: how you recruit, what you ask, how you synthesise, how it reached the product. A portfolio of projects that demonstrate your creativity and delivery of results through great consumer-facing mobile-first experiences Proficiency in using various tools and techniques to create and communicate your design ideas, such as sketches, wireframes, mockups, prototypes, etc. Experience in conducting user research and testing in different contexts and cultures, using both qualitative and quantitative methods A strong sense of empathy, curiosity, and creativity, and a willingness to learn and experiment

6631311f0d60be84.description: About the Role HUDSON is seeking a Rotating Equipment Mechanical Engineer – SME to join their team in Yanbu, Medina Province, Saudi Arabia. This full-time position requires 5-10 years of experience and offers a salary range of SAR 8,000 - SAR 10,000 per month. The role involves providing technical expertise for rotating equipment during Reliability Centered Maintenance (RCM), FMEA/FMECA, and various reliability studies. Role Purpose and Context The Rotating Equipment Mechanical Engineer – SME will support the identification of equipment functions, functional failures, failure modes, and failure mechanisms. This includes defining appropriate maintenance strategies aimed at improving reliability, availability, safety, and lifecycle performance of rotating equipment within the operational context. Key Responsibilities Act as the technical authority for rotating equipment during RCM, FMEA, and reliability workshops. Define and validate equipment functions, performance standards, and functional failures. Identify credible failure modes, failure mechanisms, and degradation processes for rotating equipment. Evaluate equipment failure consequences related to safety, environment, production, and maintenance costs. Review equipment history, bad actor reports, vibration data, oil analysis reports, and inspection findings. Recommend appropriate maintenance strategies, including Predictive Maintenance (PdM), Condition-Based Maintenance (CBM), Preventive Maintenance (PM), Failure Finding (FF), and Run-to-Failure (RTF). Assess maintenance intervals based on equipment criticality, failure characteristics, and operating context. Review OEM recommendations and industry best practices. Support Root Cause Failure Analysis (RCFA) for recurring equipment failures. Validate maintenance tasks and spare-parts requirements generated from RCM studies. Identify reliability improvement opportunities and equipment design enhancements. Provide technical guidance on risk mitigation and equipment lifecycle management. Qualifications and Requirements 5-10 years of relevant and verifiable experience in a similar role. Candidates without previous RCM experience may be considered, but under the minimum gross salary. Application Process Interested candidates who meet the requirements are requested to submit their complete documents at the earliest. The application must be provided as ONE SINGLE PDF FILE, containing the updated CV, educational qualification certificates, relevant experience certificates, and a passport copy. Please ensure all submitted documents are clear, complete, and properly arranged within the PDF.

6669489be0c160af.description: About the Role NTT DATA is seeking a Cybersecurity Consultant TVA to join their team in Riyadh. This full-time role is for a hands-on cybersecurity professional responsible for conducting vulnerability assessments, penetration testing, and security reviews across customer environments. The consultant will work closely with customers, infrastructure teams, application owners, and security stakeholders to identify security weaknesses, validate risks, and provide practical remediation recommendations. The position combines technical security testing, customer engagement, and cybersecurity consultancy to enhance organizational security posture, reduce risk, and improve compliance with security best practices and regulatory requirements. Key Responsibilities Conduct vulnerability assessments and penetration tests across network, infrastructure, server, application, and cloud environments. Perform internal and external network penetration testing within approved scopes and rules of engagement. Conduct web application and API security assessments using recognized industry methodologies and frameworks. Perform authenticated and unauthenticated vulnerability scanning using approved commercial and open-source security tools. Validate vulnerabilities identified by automated tools and remove false positives before reporting. Perform controlled exploitation activities to confirm vulnerability impact while minimizing operational risk. Assess Windows, Linux, Active Directory, databases, network devices, and security infrastructure for security weaknesses. Evaluate vulnerabilities based on exploitability, asset criticality, technical severity, and business impact. Assign risk ratings using CVSS and applicable customer risk-classification methodologies. Prepare technical assessment reports, executive summaries, and remediation recommendations. Present assessment findings and risk remediation plans to technical and business stakeholders. Conduct remediation workshops and provide technical guidance to customer teams. Perform remediation validation and retesting activities. Maintain assessment evidence, testing records, screenshots, tool outputs, and supporting documentation. Support assessment planning activities, including scope definition, methodology selection, and rules of engagement. Ensure all testing activities comply with approved authorization requirements and security testing procedures. Support security consulting initiatives related to system hardening, vulnerability remediation, application security, and infrastructure security. Assist with security assessments aligned to recognized frameworks including NCA ECC, SAMA CSF, ISO 27001, CIS Controls, and PCI DSS. Contribute to continuous improvement of internal security testing methodologies, reporting templates, and knowledge repositories. Support presales activities by providing technical input for customer proposals, assessment scope definitions, and effort estimates. Perform any other cybersecurity consulting, vulnerability management, or penetration testing activities as required. Qualifications and Experience 5-10 years of experience in cybersecurity. Strong understanding of vulnerability assessment and penetration testing methodologies. Hands-on experience conducting network, infrastructure, web application, and API security testing. Strong knowledge of TCP/IP networking, routing, switching, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, VPNs, firewalls, and enterprise network services. Good working knowledge of Windows, Linux, and Active Directory environments. Familiarity with common attack techniques including privilege escalation, credential attacks, lateral movement, and Active Directory exploitation. Strong understanding of OWASP Top 10, OWASP API Security Top 10, CVSS, CWE, and MITRE ATT&CK frameworks. Practical experience using security assessment tools such as Burp Suite, Nmap, Nessus, Qualys, Rapid7, Metasploit, Wireshark, OWASP ZAP, and Kali Linux. Ability to manually validate vulnerabilities and distinguish genuine findings from false positives. Understanding of common security technologies including WAF, IDS/IPS, NAC, EDR, SIEM, and secure remote access solutions. Basic scripting capabilities using Python, PowerShell, Bash, or similar languages. Demonstrated experience conducting internal and external network penetration tests. Hands-on experience performing web application and API security assessments. Experience using vulnerability management platforms such as Tenable, Qualys, or Rapid7. Strong working experience with tools including Burp Suite, Metasploit, Nmap, Kali Linux, and Wireshark. Experience performing vulnerability validation, exploitation, remediation verification, and retesting. Experience preparing professional technical security reports and presenting findings to customers and stakeholders. Experience assessing Windows, Linux, Active Directory, network infrastructure, and enterprise environments. Experience working directly with customer engagements within a cybersecurity consulting, systems integration, or professional services environment. Experience with Active Directory security testing is strongly preferred. Cloud, wireless, mobile application, container security, or red team experience is advantageous. Exposure to NCA ECC, SAMA CSF, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, or related security frameworks is considered beneficial. Required Skills Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to think from an attacker's perspective. Strong report writing, evidence documentation, and presentation skills. Ability to communicate technical vulnerabilities and risks to both technical and business stakeholders. Ability to manage multiple customer engagements and work independently while maintaining high-quality deliverables. Strong professional integrity and commitment to maintaining customer confidentiality. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, focusing on direct customer engagements within a cybersecurity consulting, systems integration, or professional services environment. Application Process Interested candidates are encouraged to apply to join NTT DATA and contribute to strengthening organizational security postures.

66a6fc383ab064fa.description: About the Role Saudi Services For Electro Mechanic Works Co. SSEM, a leading EPC contracting company in Saudi Arabia, is seeking an experienced Testing & Commissioning Engineer. This full-time position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and requires 5-10 years of experience. The role focuses on ensuring the reliable and efficient commissioning of electrical systems within high voltage (HV) and extra-high voltage (EHV) substations, power plants, and other industrial projects. Role Overview The Testing & Commissioning Engineer will be responsible for the commissioning of HV/EHV substations, power systems, and electrical infrastructure. This involves ensuring compliance with project specifications, safety regulations, and performance standards. The role includes conducting various electrical tests, troubleshooting system issues, and collaborating with multidisciplinary teams to deliver fully functional electrical installations. Key Responsibilities Perform testing, pre-commissioning, and commissioning of HV and EHV substations (132kV, 220kV, 400kV). Conduct primary and secondary injection tests for transformers, switchgear, protection relays, and control panels. Execute circuit breaker timing tests, insulation resistance tests, and transformer oil testing. Verify SCADA, relay protection systems, and communication protocols for substation automation. Analyze and interpret test results to identify system malfunctions or deviations. Diagnose faults in circuit breakers, CTs, PTs, relays, transformers, and protection schemes. Implement corrective actions and coordinate with engineering teams for issue resolution. Ensure all commissioning activities comply with SEC (Saudi Electricity Company), IEC, IEEE, and NETA standards. Maintain accurate test reports, commissioning records, and as-built documentation. Participate in HSE (Health, Safety, and Environment) programs to ensure safety compliance during testing activities. Work closely with project managers, design engineers, and site teams to ensure seamless project execution. Coordinate with clients, consultants, and third-party testing agencies to meet project milestones. Attend technical meetings and provide detailed progress reports on testing and commissioning activities. Ensure successful integration of protection and control systems with SCADA/DCS. Conduct final acceptance tests (FAT) and site acceptance tests (SAT). Facilitate project handover by preparing operation and maintenance manuals and training plant personnel. Recommend process improvements and testing methodologies to enhance efficiency. Stay updated on emerging technologies in testing, protection, and automation systems. Develop standard operating procedures (SOPs) for testing and commissioning activities. Required Experience A minimum of 5 to 10 years of experience in testing and commissioning electrical systems, particularly within HV/EHV substations. Company Overview Saudi Services For Electro Mechanic Works Co. SSEM is a leading EPC contracting company in Saudi Arabia. The company specializes in high voltage (HV) and extra-high voltage (EHV) substations, overhead transmission lines (OHTL), power plants, water treatment plants, water pipelines, and industrial plant projects. Location This position is based in Riyadh, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

Conduct comprehensive clinical evaluations, including history taking, physical and functional examination, and review of relevant imaging findings. Develop and implement individualized, evidence-based management plans, including non-operative management, rehabilitation, exercise prescription, and referrals when indicated. Manage common sports medicine conditions such as muscle, tendon, and ligament injuries, joint pain, overuse injuries, and concussion. 663757c95439925a.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث الجامعة العربية المفتوحة عن سكرتير بدوام كامل للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور إلى تقديم الدعم الإداري للمدير أو الإدارة من خلال تنظيم الوثائق، إدارة الاتصالات، والمساعدة في تنسيق المشاريع الأساسية وجداول الأعمال. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تدوين الملاحظات المكتوبة بطريقة الاختزال (الكتابة السريعة)، ونسخ المراسلات والتقارير ومحاضر الاجتماعات، ومراجعتها وتنسيقها وفقاً لمعايير المكتب. تلقي المكالمات الهاتفية من الموظفين والعملاء الخارجيين وفرزها وتوجيهها، واستلام الرسائل الهاتفية، والإجابة على أسئلة المتصلين، وتحويل المكالمات إلى الشخص المناسب. التعامل مع البريد الوارد والصادر، وفحص المراسلات البريدية وتسجيلها وتوزيعها. فحص طلبات الاجتماعات والمواعيد، وتنسيق جداول المشاركين في الاجتماعات، وتحديد أوقات الاجتماعات، وتأمين قاعة الاجتماعات، وتحضير جدول الأعمال. إنشاء أنظمة لحفظ الملفات والسجلات وصيانتها، وحفظ جميع المستندات بشكل منتظم. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال السكرتارية أو الدعم الإداري. القدرة على كتابة الوثائق وإدارة المكالمات الهاتفية والزوار بفعالية. مهارات ممتازة في تنظيم الوقت وتنسيق المهام. المهارات المطلوبة إتقان مهارات الاختزال (الكتابة السريعة) ونسخ المراسلات. مهارات اتصال قوية للتعامل مع المكالمات الهاتفية والزوار. القدرة على تنظيم الملفات والسجلات بدقة. الاهتمام بالتفاصيل والدقة في إعداد التقارير والمستندات. بيئة العمل يعمل السكرتير في بيئة أكاديمية ديناميكية ضمن الجامعة العربية المفتوحة في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يتطلب الدور التزاماً بالعمل بدوام كامل لدعم العمليات الإدارية اليومية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات.

66155a0485519ba8.description: At Müller's Solutions, we are seeking an Infrastructure Software Sales Specialist specializing in RedHat and Rancher to join our dynamic sales team. In this role, you will be responsible for driving sales efforts for our infrastructure software solutions, focusing on RedHat and Rancher products. Your ability to communicate the value of our offerings to potential clients will play a crucial role in expanding our market presence and achieving sales targets. Key Responsibilities: • Identify and pursue new sales opportunities within the infrastructure software sector. • Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders and decision-makers to drive the sales process. • Develop and deliver engaging product presentations and demonstrations of RedHat and Rancher solutions. • Collaborate with the technical team to understand customer requirements and provide effective solutions. • Conduct market research to stay updated on trends and competitors in the infrastructure software industry. • Achieve and exceed sales targets through effective account management and business development strategies. • Provide feedback to the product management team regarding customer needs and industry trends. Requirements: • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business, or a related field. • 3-5 years of experience in software sales, preferably within the infrastructure software market. • Proven experience selling RedHat, Rancher, or similar infrastructure solutions. • Strong understanding of cloud computing, DevOps principles, and containerization technologies. • Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills to articulate value propositions effectively. • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities to identify client needs and provide tailored solutions. • Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a team environment. Preferred Qualifications: • Relevant certifications in RedHat, Rancher, or cloud technologies. • Experience with CRM tools to track sales activities and customer interactions. • Familiarity with Agile methodologies and related tools. Why Join Us: Opportunity to work with a talented and passionate team. Competitive salary and benefits package. Exciting projects and innovative work environment.

66b245ea5d6b00fc.description: Position: Senior Speech Therapist Company: ABC Center Job Summary: We are seeking a highly experienced and passionate Senior Speech Therapist to join our team at ABC Center. The Senior Speech Therapist will be responsible for providing advanced assessment, diagnosis, and therapy services to individuals with speech and communication difficulties. The ideal candidate will have extensive knowledge and expertise in a wide range of speech disorders and therapeutic techniques. Key Responsibilities: Conduct comprehensive assessments of clients' communication skills and formulate personalized treatment plans. Provide evidence-based speech therapy interventions for individuals with speech and communication disorders. Monitor and evaluate clients' progress, making necessary adjustments in therapy techniques and goals. Collaborate with a multidisciplinary team to develop and implement effective treatment plans. Provide guidance and mentoring to junior speech therapists and other team members. Stay updated with the latest research, techniques, and developments in the field of speech therapy. Ensure compliance with professional and ethical standards in all aspects of practice. Master's degree in Speech-Language Pathology or related field. Minimum of 5 years of experience as a Speech Therapist. Valid license or certification in Speech-Language Pathology. Expertise in assessing and treating a range of speech and communication disorders. Strong knowledge of evidence-based therapeutic techniques and interventions. Excellent interpersonal, communication, and teamwork skills. Ability to provide guidance and mentorship to junior therapists. Commitment to professional development and staying updated with current research and practices.
